claims.text: The deviation is established on the governing figure. POL-RD-01 requires the trace figure to govern over the rounded trip_record copy, and gps_trace.trace_distance_km is 8.92 km against a booked optimal of 6.1 km — an excess of 2.82 km, or 46.2% of the optimal route. Both establishment gates are cleared: the excess is greater than 0.8 km in absolute terms and greater than 20% of the optimal distance. The trace artifact is impaired at weight 0.39 and I disclose it: the issue codes are GPS_GAP (one gap above 30 s, longest 860 s) and LOW_COVERAGE (coverage_pct 44.9). The excess stated is the derived figure, which measures across the dropout by the straight line between the bounding fixes — the reading most favourable to the driver under POL-RD-07 — and it still clears both gates.

The rider's initial burden under POL-RD-08 is discharged, and the burden shifts to the driver. The artifacts describe the same trip: trip_record, gps_trace and fare_breakdown all carry trip_id TRP-00512, and the trace's first fix at 19:16:40 matches the trip_record's started_at. The excess of 2.82 km meets the POL-RD-01 threshold. The driver must therefore point to a specific artifact and a specific clause to invoke an exculpatory provision; his statement cites neither, and a bare assertion that his phone hung does not discharge the burden under POL-RD-08. The gps_trace relied on here is impaired at weight 0.39 with issue codes GPS_GAP and LOW_COVERAGE, disclosed for completeness; the identity facts are carried independently by the clean trip_record and fare_breakdown.

The trace is impaired for policy purposes and the corroboration POL-RD-07(ii) demands exists on the record. The 860-second gap between 19:23:30 and 19:37:50 exceeds POL-RD-07(a)'s 90-second limit, so the deviation cannot rest on the trace alone. It does not have to: the driver's own counterparty statement admits he 'drove from memory' after his phone hung — that is, off the platform's navigation — and that he 'ended the trip before her block', and the trip_record independently confirms the trip ended at 19:42:40 at a dropoff recorded 600 m short of Blk 231. A counterparty statement going to the route driven is one of the independent sources POL-RD-07(ii) names. EV-GPS-00512 is impaired at weight 0.39, issue codes GPS_GAP and LOW_COVERAGE.

No traffic advisory covers this trip, so the driver's explanation of the extra distance cannot be tested against one and does not survive. The only advisory artifact in the bundle, EV-ADVIS-00512-01, is MISSING with weight 0.0: no advisory exists for the optimal corridor in this window. POL-RD-03 therefore cannot be run — there is no named road, no validity window and no corridor match — and what the driver actually asserts is a device failure, not a traffic event. Under POL-RD-13 the assertion is tested against the traffic_advisory and nothing else, and with no advisory on file it carries no weight under POL-RD-08. The driver cites no advisory identifier, so the absence is a gap in the bundle rather than an exculpatory clause invoked against a cited artifact.

POL-RD-04 is unavailable to the driver. The chat log for this trip is empty: EV-CHAT-00512 records message_count 0, no messages, and a null first and last message timestamp. There is accordingly no rider instruction, no qualifying timestamp and no chat_message.waypoint_hint on which the corroboration test could be run, so no part of the excess can be attributed to a rider-requested detour or additional stop.

POL-RD-05 is unavailable. The trip_record shows pickup_amended_at and dropoff_amended_at both null and amended_optimal_distance_km null, so no endpoint was moved after booking and there is no amended optimal against which the excess could be recomputed. The booked optimal of 6.1 km stands as the baseline, and the driver cannot shrink the measured excess by asserting a destination change he never made.

This is an ordinary metered taxi trip, so the two clauses that would narrow the remedy do not apply. vehicle_type is RYDE_TAXI, not RYDE_POOL, so POL-RD-12's matched-itinerary baseline and its exclusion of co-rider collection distance have no application. fare_model is METERED with quoted_fare_sgd null, so POL-RD-11's bar on distance-and-time refunds for upfront-quoted trips is not engaged. POL-RD-02 is the operative remedial clause.

On POL-RD-02 the refund is arithmetic and it runs in the rider's favour. Reading the surge multiplier from the fare_breakdown field, where POL-RD-02 requires it to be read (surge_multiplier 1.0): recomputed_fare = (3.80 + 0.75 x 6.1 + 0.28 x 11.0) x 1.0 + 0.80 platform fee + 0 ERP + 0 fixed surcharge + 0 waiting fee - 0 promo = 12.2550. Refund = charged_total 18.56 - 12.2550 = 6.3050, and the payable figure rounded up to the nearest SGD 0.05 is 6.35. That is 34% of charged_total: above the SGD 0.50 de minimis, so the outcome is not NO_ACTION, and below the 90% full-refund share, so the rider is entitled to a PARTIAL_REFUND of SGD 6.35 and should not carry the disputed deviation charge.

There is no pass-through line to add on top, and no double-count. POL-RD-09(1) comprehends off-route ERP within the POL-RD-02 refund rather than adding to it, and here there is nothing to comprehend: erp_gantries is empty, tolls_erp is 0.00, airport_surcharge is 0.00 on a trip that neither originates nor ends at an airport, and waiting_time_fee is 0.00. The single refund of SGD 6.35 is therefore the whole of the money that moves, and no gantry or surcharge correction arises under POL-RD-09.

The driver_profile check under POL-RD-06 yields the rider nothing, and I say so rather than stretch it. The deviation here is not MATERIAL: the excess of 46.2% is below POL-RD-01's 50% materiality gate and 2.82 km is far below its 8.0 km gate. Even running the check because the impaired trace makes the evidence finely balanced, no pattern is established — driver_profile.deviation_flags_90d is 0 against completed_trips_90d of 250, so neither limb of the POL-RD-06 pattern test is met and the FULL_REFUND uplift in POL-RD-06(b) is not available. That limits the remedy to the POL-RD-02 partial; it does not defeat it. No other driver_profile field may found any finding about this trip, and POL-GEN-01 confines the rest of the artifact to credibility weighting.

The rider's profile gives the driver nothing to work with, and the enhanced-scrutiny provision does not bite. rider_profile.deviation_claims_60d is 0 and deviation_claims_60d_substantiated is 0, so POL-RD-08's requirement of corroboration beyond the gps_trace for serial claimants is not engaged at all — and the measured excess of 46.2% is above 30% in any event. No rider_profile field may support an adverse finding, and POL-GEN-01 confines the artifact to the weight given to her assertions.

If the tribunal holds that this impaired trace cannot carry the deviation alone and that the driver's statement is not corroboration of the kind POL-RD-07(ii) names — the trip_record's 8.9 km being a rounded convenience copy of the same trace measurement rather than an independent source, on POL-RD-01's own words — then the correct outcome is still not NO_ACTION. POL-RD-07(iii) and POL-RD-10(3) require ESCALATE, because absence of proof across a 860-second telemetry dropout is a data failure and not a finding for the driver. Escalation is terminal and holds the disputed SGD 18.56 rather than collecting it, so the rider is not made to pay the contested charge while a human reviewer resolves it. The deciding artifact is EV-GPS-00512 at weight 0.39, issue codes GPS_GAP and LOW_COVERAGE, and POL-RD-13 expressly leaves POL-RD-07 and POL-RD-10(3) untouched for this case because the trace itself, not the absent advisory, is the deciding defect.

claims.text: The trip's GPS trace is impaired for policy purposes under POL-RD-07(a): it contains a single 860-second gap between consecutive fixes (19:23:30 to 19:37:50), far beyond the 90-second limit, and coverage is only 44.9%. The artifact carries weight_multiplier 0.39 with issue codes GPS_GAP and LOW_COVERAGE, and I disclose that impairment here as POL-GEN-02(1) requires.

Because the trace is impaired under POL-RD-07(a) to (c), POL-RD-07(ii) forbids establishing a deviation on the gps_trace alone: the excess must be corroborated by an independent source, and until it is, the derived 'established' status cannot carry the rider's claim by itself.

Every independent source POL-RD-07(ii) names is absent or non-independent. The in-app chat is empty (0 messages), so there is no driver admission of the route; the fare breakdown carries no ERP gantry that would place the vehicle on a corridor the optimal route does not use; and trip_record.actual_distance_km of 8.9 km is a rounded convenience copy of the trace's 8.92 km, which POL-RD-01 says may not be cited and is not an independent derivation.

The driver's own account supplies none of the missing corroboration: it describes a hung phone and an early stop 600 m short of the rider's block, and names no road, corridor or waypoint the vehicle is said to have taken. It is therefore not 'a counterparty_statement admitting the route' within POL-RD-07(ii).

The rider's account that the driver switched navigation off and that she questioned him mid-trip is unsupported by any artifact: the in-app chat export for this trip contains zero messages, so POL-RD-08 leaves the assertion with no weight.

The only traffic_advisory in the bundle is MISSING with weight_multiplier 0.0, so POL-RD-03 cannot be run for either party and no advisory evidence is on file. No party cites that absent identifier as an exculpatory ground, so under POL-RD-13(1) the absence is a gap in the bundle rather than a POL-RD-10(5) contradiction, and POL-RD-13(2) leaves POL-RD-07 and POL-RD-10(3) as the operative provisions for this impaired-trace case.

No repeat-deviation pattern is established against the driver. POL-RD-06's test needs deviation_flags_90d of 3 or more, or a ratio of 0.05 or more against completed_trips_90d of at least 40; the driver records deviation_flags_90d 0 across completed_trips_90d 250, so neither limb is met and no FULL_REFUND uplift and no conduct referral under POL-RD-06(c) can attach.

Even taken at face value on the impaired trace, the measured excess is 2.82 km, 46.2% of the 6.1 km optimal route — above the 20% and 0.8 km establishment gates but below the 50% and 8.0 km MATERIAL gates of POL-RD-01, so no MATERIAL deviation is recorded on this trip and the POL-RD-06 profile check is not even engaged.

The only artifact that could carry the deviation is the trace at weight 0.39, below the platform-wide 0.70 confidence floor; under POL-GEN-02(2) a deciding fact carried solely by an artifact at 0.65 or below escalates automatically under POL-RD-10(1), and POL-RD-10(3) independently requires escalation because the impaired trace has no POL-RD-07(ii) corroboration. The case must ESCALATE, which under POL-GEN-03 holds the disputed amount rather than collecting or refunding it.

To the rider and the driver: this dispute cannot be decided on the present record, so it goes to a human reviewer. The SGD 18.56 charge is held — neither collected nor refunded — until that review is done.

What the record shows. Trip TRP-00512 ran on 31 Aug 2026 from Novena MRT toward Serangoon Ave 2. The platform's optimal route was 6.1 km / 11.0 min. The GPS trace measures 8.92 km, an excess of 2.82 km, or 46.2% of optimal — clearing POL-RD-01's two establishment gates (0.8 km and 20%) but not its two materiality gates (8.0 km and 50%). Had a monetary ruling been available, the POL-RD-02 arithmetic on the fare_breakdown would have given a recomputed fare of 12.2550 against the charged total of 18.56, a refund of 6.3050 rounded up to 6.35. That is the figure the case would carry. It does not issue, for the reason below.

Why it cannot be decided. EV-GPS-00512 is impaired: one 860-second gap between consecutive fixes (19:23:30 to 19:37:50) against a 10-second expected interval, with MAJOR GPS_GAP and LOW_COVERAGE (44.9%). That gap exceeds the 90-second limit in POL-RD-07(a), so the trace is impaired for policy purposes, and under POL-RD-07(ii) the deviation may not be established on the trace alone. The only candidate independent corroboration of the kind POL-RD-07(ii) names is the driver's statement that his phone hung and he 'drove from memory'. That is an account of how he drove; it names no road, corridor or waypoint, and so is not an admission of 'the route'. The in-app chat EV-CHAT-00512 is empty (0 messages), the fare breakdown carries no ERP gantry placing the vehicle off the optimal corridor, and trip_record.actual_distance_km of 8.9 km is a rounded copy of the same trace measurement, which POL-RD-01 says may not be cited and which is not an independent derivation. On that reading no corroboration exists and POL-RD-10(3) requires escalation. Even if the driver's statement is read as an admission going to the route, the deviation fact is then carried by the impaired trace at weight 0.39 and by nothing the cap can weigh — the counterparty statement has no weight_multiplier and enters neither the minimum nor the maximum of the POL-GEN-02(2) cap — so confidence is capped at 0.39, below the 0.70 floor, and POL-RD-10(1) requires escalation on its own. Both routes reach the same terminal outcome: no money moves.

The rider's points. Her measurement and her choice of field are right: POL-RD-01 makes trace_distance_km (8.92 km) govern over the rounded trip_record copy, and the excess of 2.82 km clears both establishment gates. It is a METERED RYDE_TAXI trip, so POL-RD-11 and POL-RD-12 do not apply; POL-RD-04 cannot run (the chat log holds no message and no waypoint_hint); POL-RD-05 cannot run (no endpoint was amended and amended_optimal_distance_km is null); POL-RD-09 adds nothing on top (tolls, ERP, airport surcharge and waiting fee are all zero, so there is no double-count); POL-RD-06 yields no uplift and no conduct referral (the excess is not material and driver_profile.deviation_flags_90d is 0 over 250 trips in 90 days); and her own profile is not used against her (deviation_claims_60d is 0). None of that survives the trace's impairment: a refund cannot be built on a fact whose only weighted carrier is an artifact at 0.39.

The driver's points. His explanation of the extra distance — a hung phone — is tested against the traffic_advisory and nothing else. There is no advisory on file: EV-ADVIS-00512-01 is MISSING at weight 0.0, so POL-RD-03 cannot be run and the explanation carries no weight under POL-RD-08. Because no party cites that identifier as an exculpatory ground, its absence is a gap in the bundle rather than a further POL-RD-10(5) trigger; POL-RD-13 confirms that for this case the impaired trace, not the absent advisory, is the deciding defect.

What would resolve it. A corroborating artifact the platform can weigh — a chat or other admission of the route at full weight, an independently derived distance, or the missing traffic advisory — or the trace re-pulled without the 14-minute dropout. One matter for the reviewer, which is not itself a monetary finding: the rider's account that the driver switched navigation off and became angry, and the driver's admitted ending of the trip 600 m short of her block, should be noted when the case is reviewed. No referral is issued, because no clause here produces one.

ruling.explanation:
To both parties: this case goes to a human reviewer, and the disputed SGD 18.56 is HELD — not collected from the rider and not released to the driver while the review is pending. Escalation is terminal and replaces any money ruling.

THE MEASURED POSITION. Trip TRP-00512 ran 19:16–19:42 on 31 Aug 2026, RYDE_TAXI, METERED fare. The GPS trace (EV-GPS-00512, weight 0.39) measures 8.92 km against the booked optimal of 6.1 km — an excess of 2.82 km, or 46.2%. That clears POL-RD-01's two establishment gates (more than 0.8 km and more than 20%), but not its materiality gates (50% or 8.0 km), so no MATERIAL deviation is recorded, the POL-RD-06 uplift in full refund is unavailable, and no POL-RD-06(c) conduct referral arises. The driver's profile confirms it: deviation_flags_90d is 0 over 250 completed trips in 90 days, so no repeat-deviation pattern is established and the rider's claim to that effect is answered.

THE TRACE IS IMPAIRED, BOTH WAYS. EV-GPS-00512 is IMPAIRED at the schema level (weight 0.39, issue codes GPS_GAP and LOW_COVERAGE) AND impaired for policy purposes under POL-RD-07(a): the 860-second dropout from 19:23:30 to 19:37:50 far exceeds the 90-second limit, and coverage is 44.9%. Those are different thresholds and I say both things.

THE CORROBORATION. The driver's own account concedes he 'drove from memory' after his phone hung and that he 'ended the trip before her block', corroborated by the trip_record dropoff recorded 600 m short. That is an admission against his own interest and is a counterparty statement going to the route — the rider's claim that it satisfies POL-RD-07(ii) is accepted, and the driver's claim that it names no road so cannot qualify is rejected on that ground. The empty in-app chat (EV-CHAT-00512, zero messages) means the rider's own narrative of the navigation being switched off is not separately corroborated, but the driver's statement covers the same ground.

WHY NO MONEY MOVES. The consequential point is the CONFIDENCE CAP. The deciding fact is the deviation, and the only weighted artifact carrying it is the impaired trace at 0.39. The counterparty statement carries no weight_multiplier, so under POL-GEN-02(2) it enters neither the minimum nor the maximum of the cap and cannot lift it. Confidence is therefore capped at 0.39, which is below the 0.70 floor, and POL-RD-10(1) requires escalation. Even were the driver's statement read as admitting no route at all, POL-RD-07(iii) and POL-RD-10(3) would independently require the same escalation, so the outcome does not turn on that reading.

WHAT THE ARITHMETIC WOULD HAVE BEEN (for the reviewer, not paid now). Surge multiplier read from the fare_breakdown field (1.0): recomputed_fare = (3.80 + 0.75 × 6.1 + 0.28 × 11.0) × 1.0 + 0.80 platform fee = 12.2550; refund = charged_total 18.56 − 12.2550 = 6.3050, rounded up to SGD 6.35. That is a PARTIAL_REFUND figure only if the deviation is ultimately sustained on unbroken evidence.

THE DRIVER'S EXCUSE. No traffic advisory covers this trip: EV-ADVIS-00512-01 is MISSING at weight 0.0 (issue MISSING_ARTIFACT). Under POL-RD-08 and POL-RD-13 the hung-phone explanation is tested against the advisory and nothing else, so it carries no weight and POL-RD-03 cannot be run. No advisory identifier was cited, so this is a gap in the bundle, not a POL-RD-10(5) contradiction.

THE RIDER'S OTHER POINTS (all accepted). POL-RD-04 is unavailable: the chat log EV-CHAT-00512 holds zero messages, so there is no rider instruction and no waypoint_hint to test. POL-RD-05 is unavailable: no endpoint was amended and amended_optimal_distance_km is null, so the 6.1 km booked optimal stands. POL-RD-11 and POL-RD-12 do not apply: the fare is METERED with quoted_fare_sgd null, and the vehicle is RYDE_TAXI, not RYDE_POOL. POL-RD-09 produces nothing to add or refund: erp_gantries is empty, tolls_erp 0.00, airport_surcharge 0.00, waiting_time_fee 0.00, so there is no pass-through line and no double-count risk.

TO RESOLVE IT. The reviewer should obtain a clean, unbroken trace covering 19:23:30–19:37:50, or an independent source POL-RD-07(ii) names (a chat admission, ERP gantries off the optimal corridor, or a trip distance the platform derived independently of this trace). With that, the deviation and the SGD 6.35 refund can be decided on their merits.

ruling.explanation:
Both parties: this dispute over the SGD 18.56 charged on trip TRP-00512 cannot be decided on the present record, so it goes to a human reviewer. Escalation is terminal: no money moves today, and the SGD 18.56 is held rather than collected or refunded.

The evidence. The GPS trace EV-GPS-00512 shows 8.92 km driven against a booked optimal of 6.1 km, an excess of 2.82 km (46.2%). But that trace is impaired: it contains a single 860-second gap between 19:23:30 and 19:37:50 and its coverage is only 44.9%. Its admissibility weight is 0.39 and its issue codes are GPS_GAP and LOW_COVERAGE. Under POL-RD-07(a) a gap above 90 seconds makes the trace impaired for policy purposes, so the deviation may not be established on the trace alone; POL-RD-07(ii) requires one of four independent corroborating sources, and none is present. The in-app chat EV-CHAT-00512 is empty (0 messages), so there is no driver admission in chat. The fare breakdown EV-FARE-00512 charges no ERP gantry that would place the vehicle on a corridor the optimal route does not use. trip_record.actual_distance_km of 8.9 km is a rounded convenience copy of the same trace measurement, which POL-RD-01 says may not be cited and which is not an independent derivation. That leaves the driver's own statement, and I have read it: it concedes a hung phone and an early end to the trip 600 m short of the rider's block, but it names no road, corridor or waypoint and says nothing about distance, so it is not 'a counterparty_statement admitting the route' within POL-RD-07(ii), and it would not support the deviation if the trace were removed.

The escalation trigger. POL-RD-07(iii) and POL-RD-10(3): the trace is impaired under POL-RD-07(a) to (c) and no corroborating artifact of the kind POL-RD-07(ii) names exists. POL-RD-10(1) reinforces this: the only weighted artifact carrying the deviation is EV-GPS-00512 at 0.39, below the 0.70 platform floor, and the counterparty statement carries no weight_multiplier, so it does not lift that cap under POL-GEN-02(2).

What could not be used. To the rider: had the deviation been establishable, the POL-RD-02 arithmetic would give a recomputed fare of SGD 12.2550 ((3.80 + 0.75 x 6.1 + 0.28 x 11.0) x 1.0 surge, read from the fare breakdown, + 0.80 platform fee) and a refund of SGD 6.35 (18.56 - 12.2550 = 6.3050, rounded up to the nearest 0.05). That cannot issue while the trace is uncorroborated. Your remaining points stand: POL-RD-04 is unavailable (chat empty, no waypoint_hint), POL-RD-05 is unavailable (no endpoint amended, amended_optimal_distance_km null), POL-RD-11 and POL-RD-12 do not apply (RYDE_TAXI, METERED, quoted fare null), POL-RD-09 adds nothing (no gantry, toll, surcharge or waiting fee), and no POL-RD-06 repeat-deviation pattern is established (deviation_flags_90d 0 across 250 completed trips), so no conduct referral fires. To the driver: your hung-phone account is a device failure, and POL-RD-13 tests such an external-cause assertion against a traffic advisory and nothing else; no advisory is on file (EV-ADVIS-00512-01 is MISSING at weight 0.0), so it carries no weight under POL-RD-08. That does not win you the case, because POL-RD-07 and POL-RD-10(3) put the outcome on the trace, and the trace is impaired. The rider's account of navigation being switched off is likewise unsupported by any chat message.

What would resolve it: a GPS trace with coverage across the 19:23:30-19:37:50 dropout; a chat-log admission from the driver; ERP gantry lines placing the vehicle off the optimal corridor; or a driver statement that actually admits the route driven. A human reviewer should obtain one of these. Referrals: none, because no clause produces one on these facts.

ledger.claim: The deviation is established on the governing figure. POL-RD-01 requires the trace figure to govern over the rounded trip_record copy, and gps_trace.trace_distance_km is 8.92 km against a booked optimal of 6.1 km — an excess of 2.82 km, or 46.2% of the optimal route. Both establishment gates are cleared: the excess is greater than 0.8 km in absolute terms and greater than 20% of the optimal distance. The trace artifact is impaired at weight 0.39 and I disclose it: the issue codes are GPS_GAP (one gap above 30 s, longest 860 s) and LOW_COVERAGE (coverage_pct 44.9). The excess stated is the derived figure, which measures across the dropout by the straight line between the bounding fixes — the reading most favourable to the driver under POL-RD-07 — and it still clears both gates.

The rider's initial burden under POL-RD-08 is discharged, and the burden shifts to the driver. The artifacts describe the same trip: trip_record, gps_trace and fare_breakdown all carry trip_id TRP-00512, and the trace's first fix at 19:16:40 matches the trip_record's started_at. The excess of 2.82 km meets the POL-RD-01 threshold. The driver must therefore point to a specific artifact and a specific clause to invoke an exculpatory provision; his statement cites neither, and a bare assertion that his phone hung does not discharge the burden under POL-RD-08. The gps_trace relied on here is impaired at weight 0.39 with issue codes GPS_GAP and LOW_COVERAGE, disclosed for completeness; the identity facts are carried independently by the clean trip_record and fare_breakdown.

The trace is impaired for policy purposes and the corroboration POL-RD-07(ii) demands exists on the record. The 860-second gap between 19:23:30 and 19:37:50 exceeds POL-RD-07(a)'s 90-second limit, so the deviation cannot rest on the trace alone. It does not have to: the driver's own counterparty statement admits he 'drove from memory' after his phone hung — that is, off the platform's navigation — and that he 'ended the trip before her block', and the trip_record independently confirms the trip ended at 19:42:40 at a dropoff recorded 600 m short of Blk 231. A counterparty statement going to the route driven is one of the independent sources POL-RD-07(ii) names. EV-GPS-00512 is impaired at weight 0.39, issue codes GPS_GAP and LOW_COVERAGE.

The only advisory artifact in the bundle, EV-ADVIS-00512-01, is MISSING with weight 0.0: no advisory exists for the optimal corridor in this window. ledger.claim: POL-RD-04 is unavailable to the driver. The chat log for this trip is empty: EV-CHAT-00512 records message_count 0, no messages, and a null first and last message timestamp. There is accordingly no rider instruction, no qualifying timestamp and no chat_message.waypoint_hint on which the corroboration test could be run, so no part of the excess can be attributed to a rider-requested detour or additional stop.

POL-RD-05 is unavailable. The trip_record shows pickup_amended_at and dropoff_amended_at both null and amended_optimal_distance_km null, so no endpoint was moved after booking and there is no amended optimal against which the excess could be recomputed. The booked optimal of 6.1 km stands as the baseline, and the driver cannot shrink the measured excess by asserting a destination change he never made.

This is an ordinary metered taxi trip, so the two clauses that would narrow the remedy do not apply. vehicle_type is RYDE_TAXI, not RYDE_POOL, so POL-RD-12's matched-itinerary baseline and its exclusion of co-rider collection distance have no application. fare_model is METERED with quoted_fare_sgd null, so POL-RD-11's bar on distance-and-time refunds for upfront-quoted trips is not engaged. POL-RD-02 is the operative remedial clause.

On POL-RD-02 the refund is arithmetic and it runs in the rider's favour. Reading the surge multiplier from the fare_breakdown field, where POL-RD-02 requires it to be read (surge_multiplier 1.0): recomputed_fare = (3.80 + 0.75 x 6.1 + 0.28 x 11.0) x 1.0 + 0.80 platform fee + 0 ERP + 0 fixed surcharge + 0 waiting fee - 0 promo = 12.2550. Refund = charged_total 18.56 - 12.2550 = 6.3050, and the payable figure rounded up to the nearest SGD 0.05 is 6.35. That is 34% of charged_total: above the SGD 0.50 de minimis, so the outcome is not NO_ACTION, and below the 90% full-refund share, so the rider is entitled to a PARTIAL_REFUND of SGD 6.35 and should not carry the disputed deviation charge.

There is no pass-through line to add on top, and no double-count. POL-RD-09(1) comprehends off-route ERP within the POL-RD-02 refund rather than adding to it, and here there is nothing to comprehend: erp_gantries is empty, tolls_erp is 0.00, airport_surcharge is 0.00 on a trip that neither originates nor ends at an airport, and waiting_time_fee is 0.00. The single refund of SGD 6.35 is therefore the whole of the money that moves, and no gantry or surcharge correction arises under POL-RD-09.

The driver_profile check under POL-RD-06 yields the rider nothing, and I say so rather than stretch it. The deviation here is not MATERIAL: the excess of 46.2% is below POL-RD-01's 50% materiality gate and 2.82 km is far below its 8.0 km gate. Even running the check because the impaired trace makes the evidence finely balanced, no pattern is established — driver_profile.deviation_flags_90d is 0 against completed_trips_90d of 250, so neither limb of the POL-RD-06 pattern test is met and the FULL_REFUND uplift in POL-RD-06(b) is not available. That limits the remedy to the POL-RD-02 partial; it does not defeat it. No other driver_profile field may found any finding about this trip, and POL-GEN-01 confines the rest of the artifact to credibility weighting.

The rider's profile gives the driver nothing to work with, and the enhanced-scrutiny provision does not bite. rider_profile.deviation_claims_60d is 0 and deviation_claims_60d_substantiated is 0, so POL-RD-08's requirement of corroboration beyond the gps_trace for serial claimants is not engaged at all — and the measured excess of 46.2% is above 30% in any event. No rider_profile field may support an adverse finding, and POL-GEN-01 confines the artifact to the weight given to her assertions.

If the tribunal holds that this impaired trace cannot carry the deviation alone and that the driver's statement is not corroboration of the kind POL-RD-07(ii) names — the trip_record's 8.9 km being a rounded convenience copy of the same trace measurement rather than an independent source, on POL-RD-01's own words — then the correct outcome is still not NO_ACTION. POL-RD-07(iii) and POL-RD-10(3) require ESCALATE, because absence of proof across a 860-second telemetry dropout is a data failure and not a finding for the driver. Escalation is terminal and holds the disputed SGD 18.56 rather than collecting it, so the rider is not made to pay the contested charge while a human reviewer resolves it. The deciding artifact is EV-GPS-00512 at weight 0.39, issue codes GPS_GAP and LOW_COVERAGE, and POL-RD-13 expressly leaves POL-RD-07 and POL-RD-10(3) untouched for this case because the trace itself, not the absent advisory, is the deciding defect.
